items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Camilla Tides, she was a piano player. Miss Camilla Tides. Victor Gasper was a trimal player. Oktav Gasper was a bass player. Willie Bontem was a banjo player. And I was a drummer.

ctx.x: Also, I wonder who was in the Maple Leaf Band. Oh, all the different kinds of things.

When I was with the Maple Leaf Band? Well, I'll tell you who the Maple Leaf Band was. The Maple Leaf Band was the original Maple Leaf Band. The Maple Leaf Band was the trumpet player. Camilla Tides, she was a piano player. Miss Camilla Tides. Victor Gasper was a trimal player. Oktav Gasper was a bass player. Willie Bontem was a banjo player. And I was a drummer. That was the original Maple Leaf Band. Let's see, you got a violin or a clarinet? Did you name them? No. Where clarinet? Did I miss the clarinet? I don't…
You said you played with Chris Kelly, how many years was that?
